text: Connecting the Dots - by Sam Brinson | Derek Sivers Derek Sivers Books I’ve read : Connecting the Dots - by Sam Brinson how strongly I recommend it: 5 /10 ISBN: 1535237953 date read: 2024-11-28 About learning. I would have loved it, but I'd already read all the sources it got its information from, so unfortunately it was nothing new to me. If you understand something in only one way, then you don't really understand it at all. Turn ideas around in your mind, to envision things from many perspectives until you find one that works for you. The more a certain piece of knowledge is associated with other information, the greater chance there is of us being able to find it. Waiting for something makes it more exciting.
